gloss: to be doable; to be okay; to work

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: いけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be doable; to be possible; to work out
definitions.explanation: Colloquial expression indicating something is feasible or acceptable.

definitions.gloss: to be good; to be tasty; to be not bad
definitions.explanation: Used to express that something (food, drink) is surprisingly good or acceptable.

notes:
いける is a casual verb used to say that something will work out, is doable, or is good enough — a plan, a schedule, a portion of food, someone's singing. It grew out of the potential form of ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ and keeps that sense of "this can go through." It is ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive): the thing being judged is the subject, and there is no direct object.

ETYMOLOGY:
Derived from ⟦{行|い}ける→行く：00119_iku⟧ (potential form of ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧), extended to mean "things can go/work."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いける？ / いけます？ - Can you do it? / Does it work?
- いける⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ - I think it'll work
- いけそう - looks doable
- ⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧いける - pretty good (unexpectedly)

REGISTER:
Casual/colloquial. Common in everyday conversation.

SIMILAR:
- ⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧ - okay, all right
- ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ - can do
- ⟦{行|い}ける→行く：00119_iku⟧ - can go (literal meaning)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧いける - to be surprisingly good
- ⟦まだまだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧いける - to still have plenty left in you
- いけそう⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ - to look doable
- 〜⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧いける - to be able to manage if it is ~
